title: [Optimistic Views, Cabin]
description: Rose-colored silks drape decoratively across red pine rafters that frame a wooden grate in the ceiling.  Neatly arranged on a glass counter are velvet-lined boxes filled with a variety of wares, and a small brass tree displays some of the shop's more sophisticated offerings.  Placed prominently on the wall between some stairs and a wooden door carved with sea creatures is a brass plaque.
